sn51.22:1.2: It is typical of Ānanda to ask the Buddha on such matters. Here he elicits from the Buddha a fascinating and unique description of his meditative methods for developing special abilities.
sn51.22:1.3: He approached Anuruddha in this way ([thag16.9:10.3]()
sn51.22:1.5: For example, at [sn6.5](), [mn49:3.2](). We can deduce that this was his ordinary physical body because he disappeared from his normal place. A mind-made body is a separate entity ([mn77:30.1]()), so the physical body remains where it is.
sn51.22:4.1: On the physics of this see [dn23:17.5]().
